content:
Let \(n=y-1978\). We need \(y\) divisible by \(n\):

\[
n \mid y = n+1978 \iff n \mid 1978.
\]

Future years have \(y>2021\), so \(n>43\). Factor:

\[
1978=2\cdot 23\cdot 43.
\]

Divisors of 1978 greater than 43 are:

\[
46,\ 86,\ 989,\ 1978.
\]

So there are \(4\) more such occurrences.

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
